# T-10 — CONTENT: tune data with the simulator until every B7 target is met

**Role:** CONTENT · **Owned paths:** src/data/**, docs/content/**, docs/qa/balance_report.md (regenerated by the script)
**Inputs:** CLAUDE.md, pm/STATE.md, docs/qa/balance_report.md, src/data/*.json, src/data/types.ts, pm/handoffs/T-04-data-issues.md; read src/sim/** and src/sim/bots.ts to understand the mechanics (READ ONLY).

## Current state (5000 runs/bot)
random 100%, greedy 100%, ignite-never 99.3%, normal fight 12.3 s, boss fight 41.8 s, HK phases 100%.

## Targets (B7)
| Win rate random | 20–35% |
| Win rate greedy | 65–85% |
| ignite-never | ≥ 15 pts below greedy |
| Any single relic | ≤ 1.5× baseline share among greedy wins |
| Avg normal fight | 15–35 s at 1× |
| Avg boss fight | 45–90 s |
| Hollow King | each of 3 phases > 90% of HK fights |

## Method
Iterate: edit numbers → `npm run balance -- --runs 1000` (fast) → read the report → repeat. Levers: enemy HP/ATK/DEF/SPD/shields per tier and region, hero growth per region, ultimate power (Ignite must be decisive — e.g. strong ultimates, bosses with heavy shields that are hard to break without Ignite, enemy "enrage" damage that ramps so ending fights fast matters), ember gain rates, camp heal, gold/prices, relic values (nerf outliers), elite/boss difficulty. Prefer making fights longer via enemy HP/DEF rather than reducing hero numbers so the game still feels powerful. Keep the random bot clearly worse than greedy (it makes bad formations/relic picks — punish putting fragile heroes in front, reward synergy).
When all targets pass at 1000 runs, run the full 5000/bot (`npm run balance`) to produce the final report. Run `npm run test` at the end — if a unit test fails ONLY because it hard-codes a number you changed, write that in pm/handoffs/T-10-test-notes.md (DEV will fix) rather than editing tests.
If after honest effort a target seems impossible with data alone (needs a sim rule change), write the exact proposed rule change in pm/handoffs/T-10.md and report.
Log the main tuning changes (before → after) briefly in docs/content/BALANCE_NOTES.md.

## Acceptance
docs/qa/balance_report.md at 5000 runs/bot with all rows PASS (or a clear handoff explaining which can't pass and why).
